sampling_model.design: The design deterministically selects one proxy intervention set \(A\subseteq V\setminus\{s\}\) and acquires \(Q[V\setminus A]=P(V\setminus A\mid\operatorname{do}(A))\). Feasibility means identification of \(Q_s\) from that law under the cited hedge criterion; finite-sample allocation is outside scope.
sampling_model.units: Vertices of the fixed finite observed ADMG \(G\) induced by a recursive semi-Markovian structural causal model.
sampling_model.treatment: Acquisition of the proxy interventional law produced by intervening on the selected vertices \(A\).
sampling_model.overlap: Identification is interpreted uniformly over positive recursive semi-Markovian models compatible with \(G\), exactly as in the imported convention. This semantic positivity is separate from bow-freeness, hedge rank, costs, approximation, and vertex orders.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: None; the target is experiment acquisition sufficient for graphical identification, not estimation from finite samples.

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: Appendix D.2 gives polynomial optimization when every minimal hedge residual has size at most two, while fixed larger size only makes enumeration polynomial and leaves hitting set exponential.
Theorems 1--2 encode MCID feasibility as SAT and then WPMAX-SAT or ILP, and the conclusion leaves efficient approximation as future work.
Theorem 6 and Corollaries 2--3 make hedges complete graphical witnesses for failure of interventional identification.
Optimal fractional vertex-packing solutions have half-integral basic optima and their integral coordinates persist in an integral optimum.
Theorem 3.1 establishes APX-completeness of minimum vertex cover on cubic graphs.
Assuming the Unique Games Conjecture, minimum vertex cover has no polynomial approximation factor below two.
The vertex-cover LP integrality gap on a graph is \(2-2/\chi^f(G)\).
Weighted \(d\)-Hitting Set with an explicit hyperedge list admits parameterized search-tree algorithms.

body.tldr: Under the standard positive-compatible recursive semi-Markovian semantics, acquiring \(Q[V\setminus A]=P(V\setminus A\mid\operatorname{do}(A))\) identifies the causal target \(Q_s\) exactly when \(A\) hits every minimal residual hedge. Rank three is the first nonzero minimal residual-hedge rank for finite simple bow-free singleton-target ADMGs, and four-vertex hedges are exactly complementary directed and bidirected spanning paths. A one-private-guard expansion, oriented by a source-vertex order \(\prec\) on \(U\), realizes the edge clutter of every finite simple graph, yielding unit-cost \(\mathsf{NP}\)- and \(\mathsf{APX}\)-hardness on radius-two bidirected trees. Under the promise \(r(G,s)\leq3\), the path classification partitions every minimal residual across target parents and spouses; after polynomial enumeration in the lexicographic order induced by an independently supplied causal-vertex order \(\triangleleft_V\) on \(V\), this yields a deterministic weighted factor-two LP rounding algorithm. Consequently, the weighted natural-covering-LP integrality-gap supremum over all positive-rational-cost instances in the promised class with nonempty residual clutter is exactly two; unit-cost complete-graph expansions witness the lower bound, and the Khot--Regev threshold transfers under \(\mathsf{UGC}\) on the narrower unit-cost radius-two-tree subclass. The supplied-order promised enumerator and optimizer-or-rank-violation interface support existing exact solvers without claiming an unrestricted rank-three recognition algorithm.

project_justification.gap: The published minimum-cost intervention-design frontier jumps from polynomial solvability at residual size two to unrestricted logarithmic hardness, but it does not identify the first nonempty finite simple bow-free singleton-target rank, the exact weighted natural-LP gap at that boundary, or the approximation threshold on a graphically sparse hard subclass.
project_justification.niche: Rank-three hedge clutters are not arbitrary three-uniform clutters: every minimal residual crosses the target-parent and target-spouse partition. This structure controls every positive-rational-cost instance under the rank promise, while private guards still realize every graph edge clutter inside the narrower unit-cost class whose bidirected graph is a radius-two tree.
project_justification.fill: The paper imports the positive-compatible recursive semi-Markovian identification bridge: acquisition of \(Q[V\setminus A]\) identifies \(Q_s\) exactly when \(A\) hits every minimal residual hedge. It then proves the four-vertex obstruction classification and exact private-guard representation, transfers objective-preserving hardness, and establishes that the weighted natural-covering-LP integrality-gap supremum is exactly two over all positive-rational-cost rank-three-promise instances with nonempty residual clutter. The private-guard construction uses the source-vertex order \(\prec\) on \(U\). Separately, given a causal-vertex order \(\triangleleft_V\) on \(V\), promised enumeration lists residual constraints exactly once in induced lexicographic order before deterministic parent-spouse rounding. Complete-graph gadgets supply the matching sequence, and \(\mathsf{UGC}\)-conditional \(2-\epsilon\) hardness holds on the narrower unit-cost radius-two-tree subclass. The certifying optimizer-or-rank-violation interface is provided without asserting unrestricted recognition of the rank promise.

body.related_work: Shpitser and Pearl provide the underlying complete hedge obstruction for recursive semi-Markovian models. Akbari, Etesami, and Kiyavash define positive-compatible-model identification, reduce a single proxy acquisition \(Q[V\setminus A]\) to the no-hedge condition in \(G[V\setminus A]\), and formulate minimum-cost intervention design as minimum-weight hedge hitting. They prove unrestricted hardness and settle bounded residual size through two; their boundary is continued here at the first nonzero finite simple bow-free singleton-target rank. Elahi and coauthors replace explicit hedge enumeration by WPMAX-SAT and ILP and leave approximation algorithms open, making their RC2 and Gurobi workflow an immediate computational consumer. Nemhauser and Trotter provide the classical half-integral vertex-cover geometry that informs the argument, while the parent-spouse threshold proof here acts directly on weighted causal residuals and yields the factor-two upper bound over the full positive-rational-cost rank-three-promise class after exact-once enumeration using the supplied causal-vertex order \(\triangleleft_V\). This enumerator order is independent of the source-vertex order \(\prec\) used to orient private-guard expansions. Alimonti and Kann provide cubic vertex-cover \(\mathsf{APX}\)-hardness, and Khot and Regev provide the conditional factor-two lower bound transferred to the narrower unit-cost radius-two-bidirected-tree subclass by the exact private-guard realization. Singh's LP-gap formula motivates the complete-graph sequence witnessing the matching supremum, but no sharpening of that source result is claimed. Fernau's explicit-hypergraph branching informs only the scoped bounded-cardinality routine; neither that routine nor the supplied-order promised enumerator is presented as unrestricted rank-three recognition.
body.technical_internal_limitation: The factor-two algorithm is promise-based: polynomial enumeration is guaranteed after \(r(G,s)\leq3\) and a causal-vertex order \(\triangleleft_V\) on \(V\) are supplied, but it does not recognize that promise, and a successful optimizer run is not a certificate that the rank bound holds. The order \(\triangleleft_V\) controls only deterministic lexicographic output and is distinct from the source-vertex order \(\prec\) used by the private-guard construction. The \(O(3^k)\) exact-search guarantee also requires a supplied cardinality bound \(k\); it is not an unconstrained weighted parameterization by an unknown optimum cardinality. Finite-sample allocation and statistical estimation from acquired experiments remain outside this combinatorial identification-design result.
body.honest_scope: The equivalence between identification of \(Q_s\) from the acquired proxy law \(Q[V\setminus A]\) and hitting every minimal residual hedge is imported under the positive-compatible recursive semi-Markovian convention; no finite-sample estimation or weaker-positivity extension is claimed. The exact weighted integrality-gap supremum ranges over all positive-rational-cost finite simple bow-free singleton-target instances with \(r(G,s)\leq3\) and nonempty residual clutter. Its matching sequence and the \(\mathsf{UGC}\)-conditional approximation lower bound use the narrower unit-cost private-guard subclass whose bidirected graph is a radius-two tree. Source complexity theorems and rational LP solution are imported. Private-guard construction takes a source-vertex order \(\prec\) on \(U\), whereas the promised algorithms take a distinct causal-vertex order \(\triangleleft_V\) on \(V\), used only to make residual output lexicographic and exact once. The complexity of recognizing rank at most three, planar bounded-degree causal realizability, rank-four realizability, finite-sample allocation, and solver speedups remain open. Weighted \(O(3^k)\) exact search is asserted only for a supplied cardinality bound.
